analysis_refs.heading: Shared starting points
analysis_refs.text:
- **International:** [ILO sectors](https://www.ilo.org/topics-and-sectors/industries-and-sectors)
  links sector programs and guidance. Use its sector/country networks to find
  additional publishers. [FAO publications](https://www.fao.org/publications/en)
  links its knowledge repository; [WHO publications](https://www.who.int/publications)
  supplies health-related guidance; [IMO's Maritime Knowledge Centre](https://www.imo.org/en/knowledgecentre/pages/default.aspx)
  is a maritime discovery lead. Admission is per free item, not organization.
- **USA:** follow regulator publication catalogs, the [USDA land-grant institution
  directory](https://www.nifa.usda.gov/land-grant-colleges-and-universities-partner-website-directory)
  and [NIST MEP centers](https://www.nist.gov/mep/centers) into independently
  maintained extension/training catalogs. A center offering paid consulting can
  still publish free material; its whole service catalog is not free content.
- **India:** [NQR](https://www.nqr.gov.in/) exposes sectors, awarding bodies and
  job-role qualifications, and announces migration to [Kaushalverse](https://kaushalverse.ncvet.gov.in/homepage/repository).
  Check both during discovery and preserve original qualification IDs/version.
  [Bharat Skills](https://bharatskills.gov.in/) offers trade learning resources;
  [NSDC occupational standards and model curricula](https://nsdcindia.org/national-occupational-standards-and-model-curriculum)
  leads to sector councils and qualification packs. Their website search does
  not establish a reusable API or permission to reproduce metadata.

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I05 Building operations and facilities** — HVAC, electrical maintenance, plumbing, energy management | NIST buildings publications; OSHA; public energy-agency and facilities-training catalogs | Bharat Skills Electrician/Wireman/Refrigeration trades; NQR Plumbing and Facility Management | `site:{provider-domain} "air conditioning" "maintenance manual"`. Probe equipment model, voltage/system and version. Operation manuals and manufacturer catalogs need independent availability/reuse checks. |

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I06 Manufacturing, machining and fabrication** — CNC, welding, metrology, quality control | NIST MEP center directory → regional technical resources; NIST manufacturing publications; ILO | [MSME technology centers](https://www.dcmsme.gov.in/clcs_tus_scheme/tool_room_tech_institutions/scheme_guidelines.aspx); Bharat Skills Fitter/Welder; NQR Capital Goods & Manufacturing | `site:{technology-center-domain} (CNC OR metrology) training manual`. Probe process, machine class, units and edition; separate skills curricula from the instructional handbook. |

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I07 Automotive and vehicle maintenance** — diagnostics, servicing, EV systems | ILO transport-equipment program; US public technical-college catalogs and [NHTSA research](https://www.nhtsa.gov/research-data) as a lead | Bharat Skills Mechanic Motor Vehicle; NQR Automotive awarding bodies | `site:{official-training-domain} "electric vehicle" service training`. Probe vehicle/platform/version. Manufacturer service portals may charge or restrict access; a research report is not a model-specific repair procedure. |

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I09 Textiles, apparel and leather** — sewing, pattern making, dyeing, finishing | ILO textiles/apparel/leather sector; public vocational and textile-university repositories; OSHA workplace material | Bharat Skills garment trades; NQR Apparel, Textile & Handloom and Leather awarding bodies | `site:{training-provider-domain} "sewing machine operator" handbook`. Probe role, process, language and complete lessons. Multiple qualification packs from one publisher remain one origin. |

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I11 Energy, electricity and renewables** — solar installation, grid operations, efficiency | NIST energy publications; [OSTI](https://www.osti.gov/) research discovery; ILO energy sector | NQR Power/Hydrocarbon; Bharat Skills electrical/solar trades; [MNRE](https://mnre.gov.in/) publications lead | `site:{energy-agency-domain} "solar photovoltaic" installation manual`. Probe system scale, equipment and standard version. Recheck OSTI's supported metadata interface before selecting a connector. |

analysis_refs.heading: Industry-specific discovery matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **I18 IT, telecom and cybersecurity** — system administration, networking, incident response | [NIST CSRC publications](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications); official software-project documentation; ILO telecommunications | [CERT-In guidelines](https://www.cert-in.org.in/s2cMainServlet?pageid=GUIDLNVIEW01); Bharat Skills COPA; NQR IT-ITeS/Telecom | `site:cert-in.org.in guidelines "incident"`; repeat with software name/version. Probe exact advisory/publication ID and withdrawn status; vendor release docs and training curricula need separate mappings. |

analysis_refs.heading: Documentation review limits
analysis_refs.text:
This review inspected primary web documentation/catalog pages, not production
API requests or a hundred sources per industry. O*NET explicitly documents an
API and downloadable data; reuse that as vocabulary evidence only until the
chosen integration is tested. The NQR migration notice was observed directly.
FDA/FAA/OSHA/NIST, ROSA P, FAO/WHO/IMO and Bharat Skills pages were readable.
India's ICAR, MSME, FSSAI, NHM and CERT-In discovery links also appeared in official
search results; catalog/permissions checks remain necessary.

analysis_refs.heading: C13 — Practical, vocational and agricultural guides
analysis_refs.text:
In India, [Bharat Skills](https://bharatskills.gov.in/) describes a central
repository of curricula, course material, videos and question banks. Trace its
trade resources to DGT/NIMI and credited producers. The
[ICAR institution directory](https://www.icar.gov.in/en/institutions) supports
discovery by research division, followed by institutes, agricultural universities
and extension/KVK publication leads. Apply the industry playbook to agriculture,
construction, manufacturing and other sectors instead of inventing separate
categories for every job title.
